objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Selected corresponding document type for a document.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document; not language-independent and same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Assigned consecutive number for the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for the registered author of the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for additional personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for reviewers assigned to the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for releasers assigned to the document.

attributes.name: translation_releaser
attributes.description: Releaser attribute including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts, calculated from release of a document and updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of the extended validity is necessary; definable for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from date plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived; definable for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect distribution of acknowledgement workflow task when the next version is released.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients the document is visible or not in a multi-client system.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type used to differentiate documents and define templates, validity periods and archive duration.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document type.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for the document type.

attributes.name: document_template
attributes.description: One or more templates can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which validity extension checks are necessary for the document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive period defined for the document type.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level used to differentiate documents in a document pyramid.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document level.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and released with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Attachments are subject to their own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Attachments pass through all statuses of the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: validity
attributes.description: Attachments have the same validity as the main document when validity is extended.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Document attachment mentioned as relevant equipment or equipment supplementing a document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user of DHC VISION assigned to roles, groups, workflow tasks, distribution and document authorizations.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION for user functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for a system role.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned to authorizations, distribution, workflow roles or document properties.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for reader authorizations, authorizations and distribution.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system to assign read and change rights to documents.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the role.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role or user group whose users can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role or person responsible for authoring and signing creation of a document.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional personal change rights on a document.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role or person checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role or person responsible for deciding whether a document is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role that can translate released content of DHC VISION into another language.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document without affecting content or version history until implementation.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing change proposal can be printed in a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is near expiry.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request for AKS created for invalidating documents.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained per document containing user groups and persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Acknowledgements are listed depending on status.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and shown through notifications.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: System informs users of status and existence of workflow tasks.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system when creating new documents, additional information or attachments.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data such as IT applications linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process object with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit object with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of a released document.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Original language version of a document.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which authorized readers can see released language version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Translated version must be checked and released; visible once released.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter available for reports.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion available for reports.

attributes.name: traffic_light_status
attributes.description: Traffic light display used in reports.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard showing documents and related information.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: E-mail used to inform users about workflow tasks, release, validity extension, change proposals and acknowledgement.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.
